stem.text: A diffraction grating is used to measure the wavelength of monochromatic light, as shown in the diagram.

stem.alt: Diagram of monochromatic light entering a grating from the left. Two diffracted rays leave the grating upwards and downwards, each labelled first order maximum. The angle between the two rays is labelled 70.0°.

stem.text: The spacing of the slits in the grating is $1.00 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{m}$. The angle between the first order diffraction maxima is $70.0^{\circ}$.
What is the wavelength of the light?
